summary: Master data analytics for IT operations and infrastructure. Join our course to improve decision-making and optimize your IT environment effectively.
lede: Data Analytics for IT Operations and Infrastructure helps you turn logs, events, tickets, and infrastructure metrics into decisions that support faster incident diagnosis, service quality, and infrastructure planning. You will learn to define service-level indicators, check data quality, analyze incident and change patterns, assess capacity risk, and present findings through decision-ready dashboards. The course develops a repeatable workflow using SQL filtering and aggregation, Pareto and trend analysis, root-cause analysis, DORA metrics, SRE reliability measures, and Power BI or equivalent dashboard design. You will also create a capacity planning worksheet, incident performance report, service KPI catalogue, and improvement roadmap while exploring anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and AI-assisted event correlation at an operational level.
audienceIntro: Data analytics for IT operations is suitable for professionals who work with service performance, infrastructure reliability, operational reporting, or technology governance. It supports foundation-to-intermediate development and suits people who need to interpret operational data without becoming data engineers or software developers.
modules: IT Operations Data Quality and SQL
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to IT incidents, service requests, changes, infrastructure monitoring, or operational reporting. The course uses SQL examples, spreadsheets, and dashboard exercises, but coding or software development experience is not required. Advanced anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and AI-assisted event correlation receive operational application treatment rather than production engineering treatment.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
